# container_orchestrator/cache_manager.rb
require 'digest'
require 'json'
require 'thread'
require 'securerandom'

module ContainerOrchestrator
  class TenantIsolationPolicy
    NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR = '/'.freeze
    
    def self.validate_tenant_access(requesting_tenant, resource_tenant)
      return true if requesting_tenant == resource_tenant
      return true if requesting_tenant == 'system'
      false
    end
    
    def self.normalize_tenant_id(raw_id)
      raw_id.to_s.strip.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9_\-]/, '')
    end
  end

  class ContainerImageCache
    attr_reader :store, :mutex
    
    def initialize(max_entries: 1024)
      @store = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @max_entries = max_entries
      @access_log = []
    end
    
    def cache_key(tenant_id, image_ref, tag)
      normalized_tenant = TenantIsolationPolicy.normalize_tenant_id(tenant_id)
      image_component = sanitize_image_ref(image_ref)
      tag_component = sanitize_tag(tag)
      # Build composite key with tenant isolation
      raw_key = "#{normalized_tenant}:#{image_component}:#{tag_component}"
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_key)[0..31]
    end
    
    def store_manifest(tenant_id, image_ref, tag, manifest_data)
      key = cache_key(tenant_id, image_ref, tag)
      entry = {
        tenant_id: TenantIsolationPolicy.normalize_tenant_id(tenant_id),
        image_ref: image_ref,
        tag: tag,
        manifest: manifest_data,
        cached_at: Time.now.to_i,
        access_count: 0
      }
      mutex.synchronize do
        evict_if_full
        @store[key] = entry
      end
      key
    end
    
    def fetch_manifest(tenant_id, image_ref, tag)
      key = cache_key(tenant_id, image_ref, tag)
      mutex.synchronize do
        entry = @store[key]
        return nil unless entry
        # Verify tenant isolation before returning
        unless TenantIsolationPolicy.validate_tenant_access(
          TenantIsolationPolicy.normalize_tenant_id(tenant_id),
          entry[:tenant_id]
        )
          log_access_violation(tenant_id, entry[:tenant_id], image_ref)
          return nil
        end
        entry[:access_count] += 1
        entry[:manifest]
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def sanitize_image_ref(ref)
      ref.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\.\-\_\/]/, '')
    end
    
    def sanitize_tag(tag)
      tag.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\.\-\_]/, '')
    end
    
    def evict_if_full
      return unless @store.size >= @max_entries
      oldest_key = @store.min_by { |_, v| v[:cached_at] }&.first
      @store.delete(oldest_key) if oldest_key
    end
    
    def log_access_violation(requester, owner, resource)
      @access_log << { requester: requester, owner: owner, resource: resource, at: Time.now }
    end
  end

  class DeploymentScheduler
    def initialize(cache)
      @cache = cache
      @pending_deployments = []
    end
    
    def schedule_deployment(tenant_id, image_ref, tag, replicas: 1)
      manifest = resolve_manifest(tenant_id, image_ref, tag)
      return { error: 'manifest_not_found' } unless manifest
      
      deployment = {
        id: SecureRandom.uuid,
        tenant_id: tenant_id,
        image_ref: image_ref,
        tag: tag,
        manifest: manifest,
        replicas: [replicas, 10].min,
        state: :pending
      }
      @pending_deployments << deployment
      { success: true, deployment_id: deployment[:id] }
    end
    
    private
    
    def resolve_manifest(tenant_id, image_ref, tag)
      # Only check tenant-specific cache - no shared namespace fallback
      @cache.fetch_manifest(tenant_id, image_ref, tag)
    end
  end

  class RegistrySync
    def initialize(cache)
      @cache = cache
    end
    
    def sync_image(tenant_id, registry_url, image_ref, tag)
      # Simulate pulling manifest from registry
      manifest = pull_from_registry(registry_url, image_ref, tag)
      return nil unless manifest
      
      # Cache with tenant context
      @cache.store_manifest(tenant_id, image_ref, tag, manifest)
      manifest
    end
    
    private
    
    def pull_from_registry(url, image_ref, tag)
      # Simulated registry pull - in production would do HTTP request
      { layers: [], config: {}, mediaType: 'application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json' }
    end
  end
end
